findings.current: Once the vote began, the place where he sat would become the throne.
findings.defect: The leadership vote began in Chapter 777, and Jin destroyed the central seat in Chapter 778.
findings.rationale: This preserves Michael’s expectation of power without restarting the vote or treating the destroyed seat as intact.

findings.current: I’m afraid the first vote of our World Hunter Federation will be to expel you permanently.
findings.defect: The Federation’s leadership vote has already begun, so an expulsion vote cannot be its first vote.
findings.rationale: The threat remains clear and agrees with the vote sequence recorded in the reading copy and active state.
findings.replacement: I’m afraid our next vote will be on whether to expel you permanently.

summary: The reading copies and active state are largely consistent. Three passages in Chapter 779 conflict with the declaration and vote sequence established in Chapters 777–778.
